item.title: Ashes of Creation developer reportedly loses management and staff following troubled launch
item.description: Intrepid Studios co-founder states that "much of the senior management team resigned" following internal disputes after Early Access launch.

item.title: Austrian Supreme Court: Lootboxes Are Not (Always) Gambling
item.description: The Austrian Supreme Court has ruled in favour of Sony and EA, stating that lootboxes in FIFA Ultimate Team aren't gambling since enough skill is involved. While that's a big setback for the players that sued, it also gives clear reference to when lootbox modes are or aren't "skill-based".

item.title: Mighty No.9 and ReCore maker Comcept has been dissolved
item.description: It has been revealed that the game company comcept has been dissolved. This was revealed in a "Notice of Dissolution" published in the "Official Gazette" today (January 29th).

item.title: The former boss of MGS5 and eFootballs Fox Engine is overseeing tech on Netflixs new FIFA game
item.description: Julien Merceron previously worked at Konami, Bandai Namco, Square Enix, Ubisoft and IO Interactive, and is now chief technology officer at Delphi Interactive, the California-based studio currently working on a FIFA-branded game for the upcoming 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Numerous video game company share prices dropped following Googles Project Genie AI rollout
item.description: Unitys CEO made a statement after the tool, which lets users create playable worlds, saw its shares crashing 35%.

item.title: Arknights: Endfield Review | NoobFeed
item.description: Zahra from NoobFeed writes: As opposed to being a careful expansion, Arknights: Endfield is a bold new start. It goes against what people expect by accepting complexity while still making sense. Every system works toward a single goal that is based on strategy control and story restraint. As a result, the game needs your full attention and rewards deliberate play.

item.title: Video Game Stocks Plunge on Fears Google's Genie 3 Will Replace Game Engines
item.description: When Google unveiled Genie 3, an AI that generates explorable 3D worlds from simple text prompts, investors responded by dumping video game stocks en massewiping out billions in market value in mere hours. But in their rush to flee, Wall Street confused "playable environments" with actual video games, ignoring the technology's hard limits while threatening the human creativity that makes games worth playing. item.title: Code Vein II Review | Noobfeed
item.description: Azfar from NoobFeed writes: CODE VEIN II doesn't want to be the hardest game in the room. In its place, it centers on emotional resonance, player freedom, and ease of access. Even though technology problems and enemies that keep coming back keep it from being great, its strengths are much greater than its weaknesses.

item.title: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined Review Searching For Adventure | The Outerhaven
item.description: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined will have you adventuring until you can't adventure anymore. It will also be kind to you when you come back to look at the islands.
